newsitem.title: INDIA: PM's tax assurance boosts Delhi index 4.0 pct.
newsitem.headline: PM's tax assurance boosts Delhi index 4.0 pct.

text.p: Delhi shares closed 28.09 points, or four percent, higher as foreign and local funds increased purchases in selective stocks on the prime minister's assurance that a corporate tax will be reviewed, brokers said.
The Delhi sensitive index closed at 662.02. At mid-session, the index was around 653.07.

Prime Minister H.D. Deve Gowda said on Tuesday that he would consider Indian industry's request to remove the recently introduced minimum alternate tax (MAT) on companies when the next year's budget is prepared.
"Substantial buying by financial institutions mainly contributed to the rally in heavy-weighted stock prices," said Yogesh Sethi of brokers Vinayaka Investments.
Larsen and Toubro quoted 15.40 rupees higher at 213.40
State Bank of India gained 9.55 rupees at 215.70.
